description: Every 15 minutes from 7 AM to 9 PM (Kuala Lumpur time), checks the practice inbox for reschedule/cancellation requests, matches the patient and the upcoming Cliniko appointment they mean (ignoring cancelled ones, and using the date they name when they have more than one), checks real availability over the next 6 days, cross-checks each candidate against the practitioner's actual configured working hours, and drafts a reply. Ignores later replies in a thread it has already handled, and skips a patient who already has an open review item rather than creating a duplicate. The draft goes to a WorkQ item with a review form attached for approval — it never sends an email or changes a booking itself (see Apply reschedule or cancellation reply).

slug = params["slug"]
settings = params["settings"] or {}
state = params["state"] or {}
last_seen = state.get("last_seen_received_at") or ""
handled = [c for c in (state.get("handled_conversation_ids") or []) if c]

# No "email received" trigger exists on this platform -- this automation is
# scheduled every 15 minutes instead, tracking the newest receivedDateTime
# it has already looked at so the same email is never re-processed.
KEYWORDS = ("resched", "cancel", "move my appointment", "change my appointment", "can't make it", "cant make it")

raw = api.connectors.invoke(server="m365-mail-read", tool="list_emails", args={"folder": "inbox", "limit": 25})
messages = raw if isinstance(raw, list) else ((raw or {}).get("value") or [])

candidates = []
newest_seen = last_seen
for m in messages:
    received = m.get("receivedDateTime") or ""
    if received and received > newest_seen:
        newest_seen = received
    if last_seen and received and received <= last_seen:
        continue
    subject = m.get("subject") or ""
    preview = m.get("bodyPreview") or ""
    text = (subject + " " + preview).lower()
    if not any(k in text for k in KEYWORDS):
        continue
    # Any later message in a thread this desk already picked up -- the
    # patient replying to our offer, or a reply quoting their "reschedule"/
    # "cancel" subject back -- is NOT a new request. Replies to an offer are
    # handled by "Apply patient's chosen reschedule time".
    conversation_id = m.get("conversationId") or ""
    if conversation_id and conversation_id in handled:
        continue
    sender = m.get("from") or {}
    addr = sender.get("emailAddress") or {}
    candidates.append({
        "id": m.get("id") or "",
        "subject": subject,
        "preview": preview[:500],
        "from_email": (addr.get("address") or "").lower(),
        "from_name": addr.get("name") or "",
        "received_at": received,
        "conversation_id": conversation_id,
    })
    if conversation_id:
        handled.append(conversation_id)

new_last_seen = newest_seen
handled_conversation_ids = handled[-500:]

nodes.code:
import json

subject = params["subject"] or ""
from_email = (params["from_email"] or "").strip()
preview = params.get("preview") or ""
tz_name = ((params.get("settings") or {}).get("timezone")) or "UTC"

def cliniko(tool, args):
    return api.connectors.invoke(server="cliniko-patients" if tool.endswith(("patients", "contacts")) else "cliniko-scheduling", tool=tool, args=args) or {}

intent = "cancel" if "cancel" in subject.lower() else "reschedule"
try:
    raw = api.ai.generate(
        prompt=(
            'A patient emailed a medical/allied-health practice with this subject line: "' + subject + '". '
            "Classify the request as exactly one of: reschedule, cancel, other. "
            'Reply with ONLY JSON: {"intent": "reschedule" | "cancel" | "other"}'
        ),
    )
    ai_intent = (json.loads(raw) or {}).get("intent")
    if ai_intent in ("reschedule", "cancel", "other"):
        intent = ai_intent
except Exception:
    pass

matched = False
patient_id = ""
patient_name = ""
appointment_id = ""
appointment_type_id = ""
practitioner_id = ""
business_id = ""
appointment_starts_at = ""
problem = ""

def link_id(obj, key):
    link = ((obj.get(key) or {}).get("links") or {}).get("self") or ""
    return link.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1] if link else ""

if intent in ("reschedule", "cancel") and from_email:
    found_patients = (cliniko("list_patients", {"q": ["email:=" + from_email]}).get("patients") or [])
    if len(found_patients) == 1:
        patient_id = found_patients[0].get("id") or ""
        patient_name = ((found_patients[0].get("first_name") or "") + " " + (found_patients[0].get("last_name") or "")).strip()
    elif not found_patients:
        found_contacts = (cliniko("list_contacts", {"q": ["email:=" + from_email]}).get("contacts") or [])
        if len(found_contacts) == 1:
            patient_id = link_id(found_contacts[0], "patient")
    else:
        problem = "More than one Cliniko patient matched " + from_email + " — needs a human to pick."

    if patient_id and not patient_name and not problem:
        patient = cliniko("get_patient", {"id": patient_id})
        patient_name = ((patient.get("first_name") or "") + " " + (patient.get("last_name") or "")).strip()

    if patient_id and not problem:
        import datetime
        now_utc = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
        appts = (cliniko(
            "list_individual_appointments",
            {"patient_id": patient_id, "sort": "starts_at:asc", "q": ["starts_at:>=" + now_utc], "per_page": 50},
        ).get("individual_appointments") or [])
        # Cliniko still lists cancelled/archived appointments -- never offer to
        # move or cancel one that's already gone.
        appts = [a for a in appts if not a.get("cancelled_at") and not a.get("archived_at")]
        if len(appts) > 1:
            # More than one upcoming booking: use the one the patient actually
            # named ("cancel my 20 Oct appointment") instead of blindly taking the
            # next one. Falls back to the next one only if the email doesn't say.
            def local_label(iso_str):
                try:
                    from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
                    dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(iso_str.replace("Z", "+00:00")).astimezone(ZoneInfo(tz_name))
                    return dt.strftime("%a %d %b %Y, %I:%M %p").replace(" 0", " ")
                except Exception:
                    return iso_str
            try:
                options = "\n".join(str(i + 1) + ". " + local_label(a.get("starts_at") or "") for i, a in enumerate(appts))
                raw_pick = api.ai.generate(prompt=(
                    "A patient with these upcoming appointments (practice timezone " + tz_name + "):\n"
                    + options + "\n\nsent this email.\nSubject: " + subject + "\nBody: " + preview + "\n\n"
                    "Which appointment number are they asking about? Only pick one if the email clearly "
                    "identifies it (a date, day or time). Reply with ONLY JSON, no markdown: "
                    '{"appointment": <1-based number or null>}'
                )) or ""
                cleaned = raw_pick.strip().strip("`").strip()
                if cleaned.lower().startswith("json"):
                    cleaned = cleaned[4:]
                pick = (json.loads(cleaned.strip()) or {}).get("appointment")
                if isinstance(pick, int) and 1 <= pick <= len(appts):
                    appts = [appts[pick - 1]]
            except Exception:
                pass
        if appts:
            appt = appts[0]
            appointment_id = appt.get("id") or ""
            appointment_starts_at = appt.get("starts_at") or ""
            appointment_type_id = link_id(appt, "appointment_type")
            practitioner_id = link_id(appt, "practitioner")
            business_id = link_id(appt, "business")
            matched = True
        else:
            problem = "No upcoming appointment found for " + (patient_name or from_email) + "."
    elif not patient_id and not problem:
        problem = "Couldn't match " + from_email + " to a Cliniko patient or contact."

nodes.title: Classify intent and match the patient

nodes.code:
import json
import datetime

def cliniko(server, tool, args):
    return api.connectors.invoke(server=server, tool=tool, args=args) or {}

def read_json(path):
    try:
        raw = api.files.read(file=path, scope="org")
    except Exception:
        return None
    try:
        return json.loads(raw)
    except Exception:
        return None

def write_json(path, data):
    api.files.put(file=path, content=json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True), scope="org")

def practice_today(settings):
    tz_name = (settings or {}).get("timezone") or "UTC"
    try:
        from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
        return datetime.datetime.now(ZoneInfo(tz_name)).date()
    except Exception:
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).date()

def format_local(iso_str, tz_name):
    # Cliniko's available_times come back as UTC — showing those digits
    # directly to a patient reads as a wrong, odd-hours offer (e.g. 1:00 AM
    # instead of the real local 9:00 AM). Converts to the practice's own
    # timezone and drops the leading zero from day/hour for a natural read.
    try:
        from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
        dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(iso_str.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        local = dt.astimezone(ZoneInfo(tz_name))
    except Exception:
        try:
            local = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(iso_str.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        except Exception:
            return iso_str
    return local.strftime("%a %d %b, %I:%M %p").replace(" 0", " ")

slug = params["slug"]
settings = params["settings"] or {}
policy = settings.get("policy") or {}
tone = policy.get("tone") or "warm, concise, no jargon"
cancellation_window_hours = policy.get("cancellation_window_hours", 24)

email_id = params["email_id"]
conversation_id = params["conversation_id"]
from_email = params["from_email"]
patient_name = params["patient_name"]
from_name = params["from_name"] or patient_name or "there"
intent = params["intent"]
patient_id = params["patient_id"]
appointment_id = params["appointment_id"]
appointment_type_id = params["appointment_type_id"]
practitioner_id = params["practitioner_id"]
business_id = params["business_id"]
appointment_starts_at = params["appointment_starts_at"]

title = ("Reschedule request: " if intent == "reschedule" else "Cancellation request: ") + (patient_name or from_email)

# Guard against creating a second review item for the same patient while one
# is already open -- overlapping manual + scheduled runs (or a human
# re-clicking Run before the first pass finished) can otherwise see the same
# unprocessed email more than once and each create their own WorkQ item.
already_open = False
try:
    for row in api.workq.list(search=title[:200]) or []:
        if (
            row.get("title") == title[:200]
            and row.get("status") not in ("done", "cancelled")
            and "reschedule-desk" in (row.get("labels") or [])
        ):
            already_open = True
            break
except Exception:
    already_open = False

if already_open:
    todo_id = ""
else:
    # Flag anything inside the practice's cancellation window for a human to
    # judge rather than auto-offering a reschedule, per practice policy.
    within_window = False
    try:
        starts = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(appointment_starts_at.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
        within_window = (starts - now) < datetime.timedelta(hours=cancellation_window_hours)
    except Exception:
        within_window = False

    today = practice_today(settings)
    to_date = (today + datetime.timedelta(days=6)).isoformat()
    times_result = cliniko(
        "cliniko-scheduling", "get_available_times",
        {"business_id": business_id, "practitioner_id": practitioner_id, "appointment_type_id": appointment_type_id,
         "from_time": today.isoformat(), "to_time": to_date},
    )
    raw_times = (times_result or {}).get("available_times") or []
    tz_name = settings.get("timezone") or "UTC"

    # Cross-check each candidate against the practitioner's actual configured
    # working hours (Daily Availability) before offering it to a patient --
    # get_available_times's own docs don't document that it always respects
    # business/practitioner hours, and a live test surfaced a slot well outside
    # the practitioner's real schedule. Day-of-week mapping (0=Sunday..6=Saturday)
    # follows Cliniko's apparent Rails convention; this isn't confirmed in their
    # public API docs, so verify it against a real account's data before fully
    # trusting it on a new practice. Fails open -- keeps every raw candidate,
    # today's pre-existing behaviour -- if no daily-availability data comes back
    # at all, rather than risk silently hiding every slot behind a wrong guess.
    windows_by_day = {}
    try:
        avail_result = cliniko(
            "cliniko-scheduling", "list_daily_availabilities",
            {"business_id": business_id, "practitioner_id": practitioner_id, "per_page": 100},
        )
        for rec in (avail_result or {}).get("daily_availabilities") or []:
            day = rec.get("day_of_week")
            if day is None:
                continue
            for block in rec.get("availabilities") or []:
                start, end = block.get("starts_at"), block.get("ends_at")
                if start and end:
                    windows_by_day.setdefault(day, []).append((start, end))
    except Exception:
        windows_by_day = {}

    def local_weekday_and_time(iso_str):
        try:
            from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
            dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(iso_str.replace("Z", "+00:00")).astimezone(ZoneInfo(tz_name))
            return (dt.weekday() + 1) % 7, dt.strftime("%H:%M")
        except Exception:
            return None, None

    def within_working_hours(iso_str):
        day, hhmm = local_weekday_and_time(iso_str)
        if day is None:
            return True  # couldn't parse -- don't silently drop a real slot
        return any(start <= hhmm < end for start, end in windows_by_day.get(day, []))

    candidate_times = [t.get("appointment_start") for t in raw_times if t.get("appointment_start")]
    if windows_by_day:
        candidate_times = [t for t in candidate_times if within_working_hours(t)]
    proposed_times_raw = candidate_times[:3]
    proposed_times = [format_local(t, tz_name) for t in proposed_times_raw]

    practice_name = settings.get("name") or ""
    draft_text = ""
    try:
        prompt = (
            "Draft a short, " + tone + " plain-text email reply from an allied-health practice"
            + (" called \"" + practice_name + "\"" if practice_name else "") + " to a patient named " + from_name + " "
            "who asked to " + intent + " their appointment.\n\n"
            "Format it as a real email with actual line breaks: a short greeting on its own line, a blank line, "
            "the body, a blank line, then the sign-off on its own line.\n\n"
            + ("No real alternative times were found in the next 6 days — apologise and ask them to call the practice, as its own short paragraph.\n\n"
               if not proposed_times else
               "List these exact times as a bulleted list, one per line (each starting with \"- \"), already in the "
               "practice's own local time zone — do not convert or recalculate them:\n"
               + "\n".join("- " + t for t in proposed_times) + "\n\n")
            + ("This request is inside the practice's " + str(cancellation_window_hours) + "-hour cancellation window — "
               "acknowledge there may be a cancellation fee per practice policy, without stating an amount, as its own short paragraph.\n\n"
               if within_window else "")
            + "Sign off on its own line, using the real practice name above if one was given — never a placeholder like "
            "'[Practice name]'. If no practice name was given, sign off without naming the practice at all. "
            "Do not invent any clinical detail. Return ONLY the email body text, with real newline characters "
            "between the greeting, body, list items and sign-off — never a single run-on paragraph."
        )
        draft_text = api.ai.generate(prompt=prompt)
    except Exception:
        draft_text = ""

    description = (
        "**Patient:** " + (patient_name or "unknown") + " (" + from_email + ")\n"
        + "**Request:** " + intent + "\n"
        + "**Current appointment:** " + (format_local(appointment_starts_at, tz_name) if appointment_starts_at else "unknown") + "\n"
        + ("**Inside cancellation window — flag for judgement.**\n" if within_window else "")
        + "**Proposed times:** " + (", ".join(proposed_times) if proposed_times else "none found — no availability in the next 6 days") + "\n\n"
        + "**Drafted reply:**\n" + (draft_text or "(draft failed — write the reply yourself)")
    )

    # The practitioner reviews their own reschedule/cancellation requests —
    # hardcoded for this single-practice test setup rather than derived from
    # Cliniko (that would need the cliniko-practice connector, not bundled
    # here, plus a reliable email field on the practitioner record).
    PRACTITIONER_EMAIL = "sean.baker@mysmb.com"
    assignee_ids: list[str] = []
    try:
        users = api.users.list()
        for user in users or []:
            if (user.get("email") or "").strip().lower() == PRACTITIONER_EMAIL:
                user_id = user.get("id")
                if user_id:
                    assignee_ids = [str(user_id)]
                break
    except Exception:
        assignee_ids = []

    item = api.workq.create(
        title=title[:200],
        scope="org",
        description=description,
        priority="high" if within_window else "medium",
        labels=["cliniko-automations", "reschedule-desk"],
        assignee_ids=assignee_ids or None,
    )
    api.workq.attach_form(todo_id=item["id"], form_id=params["review_form"])

    # Save everything the apply automation needs once this item is approved —
    # the form-response event only carries todo_id/form_id/responses, not any
    # of this context. Flat filename (not a subfolder) to respect Knowledge's
    # 2-level folder nesting limit.
    write_json(
        "PracticeManager/State/" + slug + "-reschedule-pending-" + item["id"] + ".json",
        {
            "slug": slug, "email_id": email_id, "from_email": from_email, "from_name": from_name,
            "intent": intent, "patient_id": patient_id,
            "appointment_id": appointment_id, "business_id": business_id,
            "practitioner_id": practitioner_id, "appointment_type_id": appointment_type_id,
            "appointment_starts_at": appointment_starts_at, "proposed_times": proposed_times,
            "proposed_times_raw": proposed_times_raw, "conversation_id": conversation_id,
            "draft_text": draft_text, "patient_name": patient_name,
        },
    )

    # Commitment memory (healthcare-practice-management-foundation format). A
    # write hiccup here must never mask whether the patient-facing reply above
    # actually went out, so this is best-effort like every other side effect in
    # this script -- multiple automations in this extension share this one file
    # with no locking (see Apply reschedule or cancellation reply, and Apply
    # patient's chosen reschedule time, for the same pattern).
    try:
        commitments_path = "PracticeManager/Commitments/" + slug + ".json"
        commitments = read_json(commitments_path) or []
        commitments.append({
            "id": item["id"],
            "type": "reschedule_offer",
            "patient_name": patient_name or from_email,
            "description": "Offered " + (", ".join(proposed_times) if proposed_times else "a reply") + " after a " + intent + " request",
            "created_at": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "due_date": None,
            "status": "open",
            "source": {"kind": "email", "id": email_id},
            "resolved_at": None,
        })
        write_json(commitments_path, commitments)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Audit trail (healthcare-practice-management-guardrail-audit format).
    today_str = practice_today(settings).isoformat()
    audit_path = "PracticeManager/AuditLog/" + slug + "-" + today_str + ".jsonl"
    try:
        existing_log = api.files.read(file=audit_path, scope="org")
    except Exception:
        existing_log = ""
    audit_line = json.dumps({
        "ts": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "practice_slug": slug,
        "actor": "agent",
        "source": "automation:Cliniko Automations: Draft reschedule or cancellation reply",
        "action": "drafted",
        "target": {"kind": "email", "id": email_id},
        "summary": "Drafted a " + intent + " reply for " + (patient_name or from_email),
        "guardrails": [{"rule": "patient_facing_requires_approval", "result": "pass", "detail": "routed to WorkQ for approval before send"}],
        "workq_item_id": item["id"],
    }, sort_keys=True)
    api.files.put(file=audit_path, content=existing_log + audit_line + "\n", scope="org")

    todo_id = item["id"]
